name: Porkbun MCP
description: Gives agents Porkbun account access over a hosted OAuth MCP or local npm server to check, register, and renew domains, edit DNS, and manage SSL and hosting.

skills.name: Domain Registration
skills.description: Checks availability and pricing, then registers, renews, or transfers domains, with dry runs and a monthly spend limit.

skills.name: DNS Management
skills.description: Creates, updates, and deletes DNS records and DNSSEC on Porkbun nameservers, with scan-and-import for transferred domains.

skills.name: Cloudflare Zone Moves
skills.description: Moves domains to a customer's own Cloudflare account, then manages those records, the proxy, and zone settings.

skills.name: Static And WordPress Hosting
skills.description: Provisions static hosting or a managed WordPress site, deploys files, and mints WordPress credentials for an agent.

skills.name: Scoped Endpoints
skills.description: Offers no-purchases and no-topups MCP endpoints so an assistant can manage domains without buying or charging a card.
